data.name: Egg Up!
data.detailed_description:
EGG UP! is a chaotic, colorful, and laughter-guaranteed co-op parkour experience! 🐭
Play as adorable mice carrying eggs on your back, conquer four themed mountains filled with obstacles, hop into vehicles, unleash troll items to stir up the chaos, and race to the peak. Work together—or throw your friends off the cliff—victory is always paved with fun!

🎮 Gameplay Overview

  • 1–3 player online co-op (solo supported) – Learn on your own, then dive into chaos with friends.

  • Clear objective: Only if 3 eggs reach the summit will you win—don’t drop them, pass them around, protect them!

  • Parkour + survival – Manage hunger and thirst, gather loot, share (or don’t), cooperate or play selfishly.

🗻 Four Themed Mountains

Misty winter peaks, a toy/candy wonderland, lush flower-filled slopes, and a rocky route without lava (with more themes planned). Each mountain has its unique obstacles and shortcuts.
(GIF suggestion: short clip “From foothills to summit”)

🥚 Egg Carrying Mechanic

Carry the egg on your back, pass it among teammates, balance it across platforms. If the egg falls and is lost, your plans are ruined.

🚗 Vehicles & Mini Builds

Race ahead by driving vehicles in certain courses, or build quick structures to open new paths. Routes stay fresh with new combinations every run.

😈 Troll & Chaos Moments

Push, mines, bombs, throwable bees (molotov-style), and surprise gift boxes… Save your team or “accidentally” send your friend flying.
(GIF suggestion: Item chaos – short montage of bees/mines)

❤️ Revive Your Teammates

Revive a downed teammate within the time limit—balance between helping and trolling is razor thin.

🔁 Replayability

Different routes, item combinations, player interactions, and difficulty layers fill every run with clip-worthy, hilarious moments.
